name: POST /api/auth/login - sign in
description: Signs in with email and password and returns a new access token (data.token) and refresh token for the user's firm. Wrong password and unknown email return the same 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS so accounts cannot be probed. 403 NO_ACTIVE_MEMBERSHIP when the account belongs to no active firm. Covers: a user can log in. F4.4: after 10 wrong passwords for an account (or 100 from one IP address) in 15 minutes, sign-in answers 429 RATE_LIMITED before the password is checked, so even the right password is refused until the window passes; a successful sign-in clears the account's count. With two-step sign-in on, a correct password returns {mfaRequired, mfaToken, expiresIn} instead of a session (see POST /api/auth/mfa/verify).

errorCases.message: email must be a valid email address
This account is not an active member of any firm
errorCases.when: no active firm membership (needs a deactivated membership, not reproducible by request alone)
errorCases.notReproducibleReason: Needs an account whose every membership is deactivated; no API removes or deactivates members until member management (F10.2).

errorCases.message: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errorCases.when: 10 failed sign-ins for the account, or 100 from the IP address, in 15 minutes

testCases.name: 429 - account locked after 10 wrong passwords, even with the right one
